datos.observacion: Every line in the income statement for the year ending 30.06.14 is loaded, either directly or through its note breakdown. The breakdown parts add up exactly to each line: services provided 75.906, other income 29.133, third-party supplies and services 31.804, staff costs 63.181, depreciation and amortisation 13.883, provisions and impairments −2.251 (a net reversal), other operating expenses 2.539, amortisation of player registration rights 28.902, and income and expenses from player rights transactions 75.576 and 9.031. Financial items, associates and income tax are on the correct side, and no subtotals are loaded.
